game.title: Denver Broncos at Los Angeles Chargers

lede: Denver Broncos carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#17 in EPA per play), while Los Angeles Chargers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#4 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Chargers +1.6 with a fair total of 40.3 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Chargers pass offence vs Denver Broncos pass defence, which sits −0.278 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
